query: SELECT p.slug, p.name, count(r.id) AS "runs!", count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.state IN ('queued','running')) AS "runs_active!", count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'failed') AS "runs_failed!", COALESCE(sum(r.done_tasks), 0) AS "tasks_done!", COALESCE(sum(r.failed_tasks), 0) AS "tasks_failed!", COALESCE(f.open_count, 0) AS "failures_open!", max(r.created_at) AS last_run_at, f.latest_at AS last_failure_at FROM providers p LEFT JOIN scan_runs r ON r.provider_id = p.id AND ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR r.created_at >= $1) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS open_count, max(t.finished_at) AS latest_at FROM scan_tasks t JOIN scan_runs r2 ON r2.id = t.run_id WHERE r2.provider_id = p.id AND t.state = 'failed' AND t.acknowledged_at IS NULL AND ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR t.finished_at >= $1) ) f ON true GROUP BY p.id, p.slug, p.name, f.open_count, f.latest_at HAVING count(r.id) > 0 OR COALESCE(f.open_count, 0) > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(f.open_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(sum(r.failed_tasks), 0) DESC, max(r.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, p.slug LIMIT $2
